title: powerbi-pbir-mcp: Agentic Power BI PBIR, PBIP & DAX Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for Report Editing, Semantic Models and Row-Level Security — Robert Zhou
description:
Local, standard-library-only Python MCP server that lets AI agents load, scaffold, edit and validate Power BI Project (PBIP) reports saved in the PBIR format: pages, visuals, themes and layout via batched apply plans, plus semantic model tables, DAX measures, relationships, hierarchies, perspectives and row-level security (RLS) roles.

Built by Robert Zhou during his enterprise AI work at Parsifal Corporation, where it was one of four internal MCP servers (SQL, Power BI, M365, AI governance) alongside a .NET 8 billing engine. Works with Codex, Claude Code and other MCP clients over stdio.

Author: Robert Zhou, Colby College. Portfolio: robertzhou.dev. Project write-up: https://robertzhou.dev/work/parsifal-billing/. Source: github.com/bobzhou-source/powerbi-pbir-mcp.
